seoTitle: About PAO OS | An AI Operating System for Businesses
description: Discover PAO OS, an AI Agent-powered business operating system developed by IVN Network in Vietnam to connect work and automate operations.
title: About PAO OS
subtitle: PAO OS – A Business Operating System for the AI era
intro: Technology is changing how businesses work. Artificial intelligence can help with research, planning, data analysis, content creation and an increasing range of complex tasks.
Yet most tools still operate separately. People have to connect information, hand over results and coordinate work across different systems themselves.
**PAO OS is being developed to change that way of working.**
Developed in Vietnam by IVN Network, PAO OS is an AI-powered Business Operating System platform that aims to connect people, data, work and AI Agents in a shared operating environment.
PAO’s goal is to help businesses use AI in a more organized, effective and manageable way.

sections.title: Why are we building PAO OS?
sections.subtitle: Businesses do not lack tools. What is missing is connection.
paragraphs: A business today may use dozens of applications to manage projects, run marketing, sell products, serve customers and manage internal operations.
Each application meets a specific need. But when systems do not connect, staff still spend considerable time transferring data, compiling reports, tracking progress and coordinating work.
AI helps many tasks get done faster. However, if each AI handles only an independent task, users still have to organize the entire process themselves.
That experience led us to a question:
**What would happen if AI systems could work together, use the tools they need and help businesses handle work within one shared system?**
This question became the foundation for PAO OS’s development.
Rather than creating another standalone tool, we aim to build an intelligent coordination layer that can connect systems and organize work from the moment a request arrives through to completion.

sections.title: PAO OS – From an AI assistant to a work coordination system
sections.subtitle: AI taking part in the process, rather than only providing answers
paragraphs: PAO OS is being developed around the **AI Chief of Staff** model combined with a **Multi-Agent System** architecture.
In this model, PAO AI serves as the central point for receiving requests, helping plan work and coordinating AI Agents with suitable expertise.
A task can be broken into steps such as researching information, analyzing data, preparing content, bringing results together and sending them to the responsible person for approval.
AI Agents are designed to coordinate through the task management system, integrated tools and configured workflows.
PAO aims for a new way of working:
**People set the goals. AI helps organize and carry out work. The business controls the process and the results.**
This is the core direction behind developing PAO from an AI assistant into a platform that supports business operations.

sections.title: Developed for businesses
sections.subtitle: AI technology needs to fit how businesses actually operate
paragraphs: PAO OS is intended for a range of users, from managers, marketing and sales teams to departments that regularly coordinate work and handle data.
Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) are a particular focus.
We understand that not every business has a dedicated technology team or the resources to build complex automation systems.
That is why PAO OS for SME is developed around clear directions:
items: **Accessible:** Apply AI to familiar tasks and needs.
**Flexible:** Choose suitable features, AI Agents and deployment options.
**Connected:** Make use of the software and services the business already uses.
**Controlled:** Manage access permissions, approval processes and the scope of AI actions.
**Scalable:** Start with priority processes and expand according to actual needs.
after: PAO does not aim to make businesses replace all their existing systems. Instead, the platform is designed to help connect and get more value from the tools already in use.

sections.title: The principles behind PAO OS
sections.subtitle: Flexible technology. Practical applications. People retain control.
paragraphs: The world of AI is changing quickly. New language models, platforms and tools keep appearing, opening up an increasingly broad range of applications.
We believe a business AI platform needs to adapt to those changes.
PAO OS therefore pursues a flexible architecture, aiming to connect multiple AI models, services and business applications through compatible integration methods.
Alongside automation, PAO pays attention to transparency, permissions and control over system activity.
AI can help carry out work, but important decisions still need oversight and approval from an authorized person.
We also believe the value of technology lies in solving real problems, rather than the number of features it offers.
PAO OS continues to be developed, tested and improved in stages, based on usage needs, deployment results and businesses’ emerging requirements.

sections.title: PAO OS is developed by IVN Network
sections.subtitle: Developing AI technology from Vietnam
paragraphs: **IVN Network** develops PAO OS in Vietnam, focusing on software solutions, AI Agents and automation technology for business operations.
PAO OS is one of IVN Network’s product development directions, bringing software engineering, artificial intelligence and business knowledge together in a shared platform.
We aim to build AI products that are practical, accessible and able to grow with users’ needs.
PAO OS has been introduced to the market and continues to be refined according to its product roadmap.

sections.title: The vision for PAO OS
sections.subtitle: Making AI a natural part of how businesses work
paragraphs: We imagine a working environment where people no longer have to spend so much time connecting tools, transferring data or repeating the same actions.
Instead, businesses can focus on goals, strategy and the decisions that really matter.
AI will help organize work, coordinate resources and handle suitable tasks within the permitted scope.
**PAO OS’s vision is to build an AI-centered business operating system where people and AI Agents can work together more effectively.**
This is the direction IVN Network is gradually making a reality with PAO OS.

closing.title: Explore the future of business operations with PAO OS
closing.paragraph: Every business faces its own challenges. PAO OS is being developed to help you approach AI through real needs, choose suitable solutions and gradually build smarter workflows.
